title: 第19章 天劫之威第20章 剿灭擎天盟
slug: 惊天剑帝第7906章空气太敏感
content_zh:
一道神雷打在林白身上，吞噬剑魂极快的速度便将雷霆之力吞入武魂中。
虽然这道雷霆并没有给林白带来创伤。
但是雷霆落下的剧烈疼痛，但是让林白牙齿一咬。
“放开我，放开我，放开我！”铁海棠被林白搂入怀中，愤怒的剧烈挣扎起来。
“你到底想怎么样啊。”林白不可奈何的问道。
“我不要你管，你给我走，走啊。”铁海棠哭着说道。
“哎！”
林白轻叹一声，翻身将铁海棠按在自己的大腿上。
“你想干什么？”铁海棠趴在林白的大腿上，紧张的问道。
“干什么，我叫你不听话，不听话，不听话！”
林白一狠，挥起手掌，啪啪啪的打在铁海棠的矫臀上，每打下去一巴掌，娇臀就轻颤两三下，十分的有弹性。
臀部上传来的火辣痛感，让铁海棠满心屈辱，但却……又有一丝兴奋……
于是，在雷泽中就出现了这一副画面。
一个白衣少年，顶着九天雷霆，打着一个少女的娇臀。
真特么的刺激！
“呜呜……”铁海棠被打得越哭越凶了。
“听不听话？”林白问道。
“听话。”
铁海棠只得弱弱的说道。
被人扇耳光，也只是脸上的疼痛，可被林白大屁股，却让铁海棠感觉不到疼痛，反而有一丝兴奋感，这就让她有些受不了了。

“那跟我回去吧。”林白说道。
“好。”铁海棠弱弱道。
“果然啊，女人要作，打一顿屁股就好了。”林白嘴角带着一丝邪魅笑容的说道。
“手感不错。”
林白坏笑一声。
咔咔咔！
正当林白要带着铁海棠离开的时候，突然在顶部乌云之中，一丝丝红色的电流逐渐的浮现出来。
“这神雷怎么变了颜色？”林白惊骇的抬头看去。
轰隆隆~
一声巨大的雷鸣传来，乌云中出现的红色雷霆一瞬间将所有的紫色雷霆全部吞噬了。
天空之上，红色雷霆宛如灭世之雷，散发着毁天灭地的力量！
content_en:
A bolt of divine thunder struck Lin Bai, swallowing the sword soul very quickly and swallowing the power of thunder into the martial soul.
Although this thunder did not bring trauma to Lin Bai.
But the severe pain caused by the thunder made Lin Bai bite his teeth.
"Let me go, let me go, let me go!" Tie Haitang was hugged by Lin Bai and struggled violently in anger.
"What do you want?" Lin Bai asked helplessly.
"I don't want you to worry about it. Just leave. Let's go." Tie Haitang cried.
"Hey!"
Lin Bai sighed softly, turned over and pressed Tie Haitang on his thigh.
"What do you want to do?" Tie Haitang asked nervously, lying on Lin Bai's lap.
"What are you doing? I told you to disobey, disobey, disobey!"
Lin Bai was fierce, waved his palm, and slapped Tie Haitang's buttocks. Every time he slapped her, her buttocks would tremble two or three times, making them very elastic.
The burning pain from his buttocks filled Tie Haitang with humiliation, but... there was also a hint of excitement...
As a result, this scene appeared in Lei Ze.
A young man in white, with the thunder of nine days, spanked a girl's delicate buttocks.
How exciting!
"Woo..." Tie Haitang cried more and more fiercely after being beaten.
"Are you obedient?" Lin Bai asked.
"Be obedient."
Tie Haitang could only say weakly.
Being slapped in the face only caused pain on the face, but being slapped on the butt by Lin Bai made Tie Haitang feel no pain, but a sense of excitement, which made her a little unbearable.
"Then come back with me." Lin Bai said.
"Okay." Tie Haitang said weakly.
"Sure enough, if a woman wants to do something, just give her a spanking." Lin Bai said with a sinister smile on his lips.
"It feels good."
Lin Bai gave a bad laugh.
Click, click, click!
Just as Lin Bai was about to leave with Tie Haitang, suddenly, among the dark clouds at the top, traces of red electricity gradually emerged.
"Why did this divine thunder change its color?" Lin Bai looked up in horror.
Rumble~
There was a huge thunder, and the red thunder that appeared in the dark clouds swallowed up all the purple thunder in an instant.
In the sky, the red thunder is like a world-destroying thunder, exuding the power to destroy the world!
